title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
taper: Uher mic > Uher 4000 Report L 5" reels > MacIntosh pre-amp > TEAC 1230 7" reel.

ai_review.summary: A raw soundboard capture with plenty of teeth delivers a spirited set highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, heartfelt Sugar Magnolia and an inspired Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is a straight‑from‑the‑board mix that retains its natural dynamics – a little vocal clipping, occasional mic‑cable wobble and even a brief pause on Casey Jones, but those quirks give it authenticity. Musically the show is energetic and full of standout moments, from an expansive Dark Star and beautifully paced Eyes of the World to a tear‑inducing first‑time Sugar Magnolia. Overall it’s an enjoyable listen that makes the day for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews consistently praise the performance (especially Dark Star, Eyes of the World and Sugar Magnolia) while noting only minor raw‑recording quirks; weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw, uncompressed mix with noticeable vocal clipping on Eyes of the World, occasional mic‑cable movement and a brief pause during Casey Jones; overall clear enough to enjoy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Spirited and energized performance with an unconventional second‑set opener (Around and Around) that still flows well into strong jams; overall set feels cohesive and lively.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for delivering one of the reviewer’s favorite Dark Stars and noted as a “Jerry birthday show.”
